correctness.rationale: With Laguerre L_n^(0)(0)=1 orthonormal for weight e^-x, the signed primitive F_n(x)=x e^-x L_(n-1)^(1)(x)/n vanishes at 0 and infinity. Stieltjes integration by parts gives sharp BV coefficient bound with a single jump extremizer. The exact ODE F_n''+F_n'+nF_n/x=0 yields Sonin derivative S_n′=(1-2x)(F_n′)^2/n, so the maximum lies at one of the Laguerre roots nearest 1/2. Classical compact-uniform Plancherel–Rotach asymptotics give n^(3/2) S_n(x)→e^-x sqrt(x)/pi and limit n^(3/4) M_n=e^(-1/4)/(2^(1/4)sqrt(pi)). An oscillatory near-1/2 peak supplies lower matching bound; envelope monotonicity gives argmax localization. Numeric independent checks of n=100..800 corroborate only.
